channel_identity.name: AniDoc
channel_identity.motto: Real events. Hidden facts. Untold realities. Cinematic 2D animated documentary storytelling.
channel_identity.niche: True Crime, Espionage, Political History, Geopolitical Secrets, Untold Realities
channel_identity.language: Hindi / Urdu flavored formal Hindi / English Documentary

script_dna.hook_structure: Opens mid-action with precise date, city/location, and sensory detail within first 3 sentences.
script_dna.sentence_rhythm: Short punchy sentences, max 2 clauses, alternating rapid bursts with slow dramatic pauses.
script_dna.tone: Third-person cinematic narrator, grave, authoritative, restrained, investigative.

visual_dna.art_style: Semi-realistic 2D illustration, clean outlines, no texture noise, accurate human anatomy, South Asian facial features.
visual_dna.color_palette: Warm muted tones: amber, khaki, dusty olive, deep navy, charcoal black. Warm golden/brown skin tones. Desaturated backgrounds.
visual_dna.lighting: Single-source dramatic lighting, strong side-light or overhead spotlight, deep cinematic shadows.
visual_dna.camera_framing: Medium-close portrait shots (chest up) for characters, wide establishing shots for locations, low-angle for power figures.
visual_dna.negative_prompt: 3d render, cartoon, anime, bright neon, saturated childish colors, flat lighting, distorted faces, extra limbs, blurry

thumbnail_dna.headline_format: Devanagari Bold White text + 1 keyword highlighted in Red or Yellow
thumbnail_dna.composition: Split composition: Dark dramatic left + contextual right
thumbnail_dna.character_placement: 1-2 large illustrated figures, chest up, intense/shocked expression, center/right
thumbnail_dna.badge: 2D ANIMATION in yellow rounded rectangle at bottom center
